description.value: FIVE Kitchen & Raw Oyster Bar is a seafood restaurant situated directly across from the famous White Rock pier, offering sweeping ocean and sunset views from its waterfront location on Marine Drive. The kitchen blends New England-style cuisine with global flavours, drawing on fresh and live seafood sourced primarily from local BC and Canadian fisheries, all prepared by Red Seal-certified chefs. A patio is available, and the restaurant's position on the Marine Drive waterfront corridor makes it a natural destination for cyclists touring the South Surrey and White Rock coastline.
